mechanismTable.name: serve-time body predicate
mechanismTable.why: classifySetbackRuleAtom already reads front/side/rear. applySetbackProvenanceServe is on getPropertyAtomChain and assembleChain. No schema change, no mutation, no unwind. After Bastrop bake replaces body on the same atom_did, the next read returns value.
mechanismTable.rejectedAlternative: a stored quarantine mark keyed on atom_did (E without hash). Rejected because writePropertyAtom upserts body in place and nothing clears a side mark.

mechanismTable.name: access_policy
mechanismTable.why: resolveAccessPolicyOrRefuse (packages/storage/src/access-policy-write.ts) refuses only null and empty string. It does not validate an enum. An invented quarantined would write. accessPolicyMatchesFilter then hides the atom on every surface, collapsing unknown into absent. Collides with the 2026-08-28 access-pair ruling.
mechanismTable.rejectedAlternative: use access_policy as a truth flag because it is a writable column. Rejected by the write-path read: writable is not the same as semantically a quarantine.

mechanismTable.name: status=retired
mechanismTable.why: atoms has no status column. body.status is PropertyAtomStatus active|retired and is read (coalesce active) and written by road-ingest-supersede. retired means superseded and is not served. That turns unknown into absence on 188103 parcels and rewrites content_hash and cid. Correct only for a genuine supersede.
mechanismTable.rejectedAlternative: it is armed and fed, so flip it. Rejected: armed-and-fed is why it is tempting, not why it is right here.

mechanismTable.name: delete
mechanismTable.why: Forbidden on F-11. Converts a wrong value into an absence. Absent, zero, and unmeasured stay three states.
mechanismTable.rejectedAlternative: delete to make the rail look clean. Rejected by the card and by the three-state rule.

mechanismTable.name: side table or atom_links mark on atom_did
mechanismTable.disposition: available, not adopted; hash-bind required if used
mechanismTable.why: atom_links exists. A mark keyed only on atom_did is stale by construction after the Bastrop bake upsert. If used, record content_hash and invalidate when the body hash changes.
mechanismTable.rejectedAlternative: mark now, clear later by hand. Rejected: no unwind is a defect, not a follow-up.

mcpIccMeterRequest.impact: Every MCP get_property_atom_chain that returns a setback-rule citing the placeholder DID currently accrues a license-reference-royalty obligation against the ICC actor (citedAtomDid allowlist hit). Mechanism A on the engine serve path does not change that, because MCP passes the raw atom through and never reads setbackServe. Removing or reclassifying citations changes the meter's input. Gate A still needs the proof code-section DID itself to remain allowlisted and servable.
mcpIccMeterRequest.quantify: unmeasured until F1. Published floor is 188103 citing setback-rule rows. Each successful tool read of one such atom is one accrual pair. Do not treat timeout as 0.
mcpIccMeterRequest.request: Split the allowlist: keep accruing when the proof code-section atom itself is read (Gate A). Stop accruing license-reference-royalty when a setback-rule merely cites that DID. Do not remove the DID from Gate A search/get.
